Effect of captopril, an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor, in patients with angina pectoris and heart failure. The effects of captopril and placebo were compared in 18 patients with chronic heart failure and angina pectoris with use of a double-blind crossover trial design. Symptoms were assessed by patient treatment preference, visual analogue scores and nitroglycerin consumption. results.text: [Essential arterial hypertension and quality of life. Comparative crossed double-blind study of labetalol and captopril].
